hunks.baseline: At the very first moment he clashed with Jin Taekyung, the black knight instinctively realized it.
hunks.sol: The moment he first clashed with Jin Taekyung, the black knight knew instinctively.

hunks.baseline: *Strong.*
hunks.sol: *He’s strong.*

hunks.baseline: The young human before him was an unbelievably powerful opponent. Someone whose strength was so great that even if the black knight gave it everything he had, he could not guarantee victory—or perhaps someone even stronger than that.
hunks.sol: The young human before him was extraordinarily powerful. Even if the black knight fought with everything he had, victory was far from certain. His opponent might even be stronger than he was.

hunks.baseline: As they traded attack and defense again and again, the thought only grew firmer.
hunks.sol: As the battle seesawed back and forth, that conviction only deepened.

hunks.baseline: But the black knight was neither frightened nor willing to retreat.
hunks.sol: But the black knight neither feared him nor retreated.

hunks.baseline: He was his lord’s most loyal servant, a being entrusted with the mission of carrying out his orders.
hunks.sol: He was his lord’s most loyal servant, charged with carrying out his commands.

hunks.baseline: This was a battle between powerful beings who had transcended their limits. Even the slightest difference could turn victory into defeat.
hunks.sol: This was a battle between warriors who had transcended their limits. Even the slightest difference could decide the outcome.

hunks.baseline: *If I do not give up, an opportunity will come.*
hunks.sol: *If I don’t give up, an opportunity will come.*

hunks.baseline: It was something he had repeated to himself ever since he was a child in training, and surviving countless battles had allowed him to grow into a powerful warrior.
hunks.sol: He had repeated those words to himself ever since his childhood training. By surviving countless battles, he had grown into a mighty warrior.
*…I did?*

hunks.baseline: Confusion came over him again. As his mind grew disordered, his hands and feet grew clumsy.
hunks.sol: Confusion struck again. The moment his thoughts faltered, his movements became erratic.

hunks.baseline: And his opponent was neither weak nor careless enough to miss such an opening.
hunks.sol: And his opponent was neither weak nor careless enough to let such an opening pass.

hunks.baseline: Whoosh, scrape!
hunks.sol: Whoosh! Slash!

hunks.baseline: Amid that heat, so intense it seemed close enough to grasp, the black knight suddenly felt something.
hunks.sol: Amid the almost tangible heat, the black knight suddenly felt something.

hunks.baseline: The name of that sensation was pain.
hunks.sol: Pain.

hunks.baseline: What disconcerted the black knight was not the fact that he could feel pain, but that a sensation which should have been completely unfamiliar felt so terribly familiar.
hunks.sol: What unsettled him was not that he could feel pain, but that a sensation which should have been utterly foreign felt so terribly familiar.

hunks.baseline: His chest throbbed, and his head pounded.
hunks.sol: His chest throbbed. His head pounded.

hunks.baseline: As the black knight staggered under the relentless barrage of attacks, memories belonging to someone whose identity he could not possibly determine flashed rapidly before his eyes.
hunks.sol: As the black knight staggered beneath the relentless barrage, memories belonging to someone he could not identify flashed rapidly before his eyes.

hunks.baseline: *This, this can’t be!*
hunks.sol: *Th-This can’t be!*

hunks.baseline: “He needs to be placed in the Zhonghua Development Training program immediately!”
hunks.sol: “He must be enrolled in the Zhonghua Development Training program immediately!”

hunks.baseline: Humans in dazzling white clothes chattered in excited voices. Standing among them was a middle-aged man dressed in a dark, angular uniform.
hunks.sol: Humans in spotless white coats spoke in excited voices. Among them stood a middle-aged man in a dark, sharply tailored uniform.

hunks.baseline: “Zhonghua Development Training? Are you saying you intend to raise that child as a Hunter?”
hunks.sol: “Zhonghua Development Training? You intend to raise that child as a Hunter?”

hunks.baseline: “Of course. He’s only thirteen years old, yet his mana adaptability is comparable to Faye Chen’s. He has more than enough potential to become an S-rank Hunter—the best Hunter in the country!”
hunks.sol: “Of course. He is only thirteen, yet his mana adaptability is comparable to Faye Chen’s. He has more than enough potential to become an S-rank Hunter—the greatest Hunter in our nation!”

hunks.baseline: “Pardon me?”
hunks.sol: “Pardon?”

hunks.baseline: “No, Comrade Lieutenant General. What do you mean? This child…”
hunks.sol: “Comrade Lieutenant General, what do you mean? This child…”

hunks.baseline: “He is my only nephew. I promised my sister that I would make the boy happy, not turn him into a Hunter and put him in danger.”
hunks.sol: “He is my only nephew. I promised my sister I would make him happy, not turn him into a Hunter and put him in danger.”

hunks.baseline: “Being a Hunter is a noble profession. If that child becomes an S-rank Hunter, he will be a blessing to the entire people!”
hunks.sol: “Being a Hunter is a noble calling. If that child becomes an S-rank Hunter, it will be a blessing to all our people!”

hunks.baseline: “I know how noble the work they do is. But that is how my brother-in-law also…”
hunks.sol: “I know how noble their work is. But that was how my brother-in-law…”

hunks.baseline: The middle-aged man suddenly stopped and shook his head.
hunks.sol: The middle-aged man stopped and shook his head.

hunks.baseline: “No matter what you say, I will not change my mind. If there had been no directive from above, I would not even have had him tested. We will be leaving now, so handle the rest yourselves.”
hunks.sol: “Nothing you say will change my mind. If not for the directive from above, I would never have allowed him to be tested. We’re leaving. The rest is up to you.”

hunks.baseline: Leaving the shouts echoing behind him, the middle-aged man strode over with a forced smile and held out his hand.
hunks.sol: Leaving the shouts behind him, the middle-aged man strode over, forced a smile, and held out his hand.

hunks.baseline: “You’ve been waiting long, haven’t you? Come on, let’s go.”
hunks.sol: “You’ve been waiting a long time, haven’t you? Come on. Let’s go.”

hunks.baseline: The black knight—or rather, the man who seemed to be the owner of these memories—grasped the middle-aged man’s hand.
hunks.sol: The black knight—or rather, the person whose memories these seemed to be—took the middle-aged man’s hand.

hunks.baseline: A small, pale hand.
hunks.sol: His own hand was small and pale.

hunks.baseline: Then a clear child’s voice rang out.
hunks.sol: Then a child’s clear voice rang out.

hunks.baseline: A complicated array of emotions crossed the middle-aged man’s face.
hunks.sol: A host of emotions crossed the middle-aged man’s face.

hunks.baseline: After staring at the child while biting his lip for a long time, he let out a worried sigh. Then the humans whose expressions had brightened considerably approached him.
hunks.sol: He stared at the child for a long time, biting his lip. When he finally released a troubled sigh, the others approached with markedly brighter expressions.

hunks.baseline: “Zhonghua Development Training is a project we developed with painstaking care. Its safety measures are thorough, and its effectiveness is proven. Wu Heixing, who is the same age, is doing well too.”
hunks.sol: “Zhonghua Development Training is a project we designed with the utmost care. Its safety measures are rigorous, and its effectiveness is proven. Wu Heixing is the same age, and he’s doing well.”

hunks.baseline: “If the child changes his mind, we will stop the training at any time.”
hunks.sol: “If the child changes his mind, we’ll stop the training at any time.”

hunks.baseline: The oldest-looking man placed a hand on the middle-aged man’s shoulder.
hunks.sol: The oldest among them placed a hand on the middle-aged man’s shoulder.

hunks.baseline: The name echoed endlessly through the black knight’s mind. A name that felt so familiar, and so dearly missed.
hunks.sol: The name echoed endlessly through the black knight’s mind.
It was so familiar.
He had missed it so much.

hunks.baseline: Was the throbbing in his chest caused by the attack he had taken, or was there another reason?
hunks.sol: Did his chest ache because of the blow he had taken, or was there another reason?

hunks.baseline: As the staggering black knight stared ahead, more memories appeared before his eyes.
hunks.sol: As the black knight staggered, another memory appeared before his eyes.

hunks.baseline: A boy in a bow tie and black suit glared at him with sharp eyes. His polished shoes gleamed.
hunks.sol: A boy in a bow tie, black suit, and polished shoes glared at him.

hunks.baseline: “Don’t get confused. I’m the best. You’re second!”
hunks.sol: “Don’t get the wrong idea. I’m the best. You’re second!”

hunks.baseline: The black knight’s vision tilted to one side, and then an innocent voice rang out.
hunks.sol: The black knight’s view tilted as his head cocked to one side, and an innocent voice emerged.

hunks.baseline: “Okay. Let’s do that, then.”
hunks.sol: “Okay. We’ll do that, then.”

hunks.baseline: “I like being second, too. Third is fine, and I don’t care if I come in last.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t mind being second. Third is fine too, and I wouldn’t care if I came in last.”

hunks.baseline: “Are you stupid? Do you want to become worse than Zhang Wei, the last-place trainee at the training camp?”
hunks.sol: “Are you stupid? You want to be even worse than Zhang Wei, the lowest-ranked trainee in the whole training camp?”

hunks.baseline: “But Zhang Wei is kind and helps other people, too. He’ll become a great Hunter.”
hunks.sol: “But Zhang Wei is kind, and he’s always helping others. He’ll become a great Hunter.”

hunks.baseline: “Y-You’re making fun of me right now, aren’t you?”
hunks.sol: “Y-You’re making fun of me, aren’t you?”

hunks.baseline: “Huh? No. I just… whatever you want is fine with me—ah!”
hunks.sol: “Huh? No. I just meant that if that’s what you want, then I’m fine with—ah!”

hunks.baseline: Subduing the boy who suddenly lunged at him took only an instant. The boy pinned beneath him struggled and shouted.
hunks.sol: It took only an instant to subdue the boy who had suddenly lunged at him. Pinned beneath him, the boy thrashed and shouted.

hunks.baseline: When one memory disappeared, another appeared in its place, as though someone were tossing stones one after another into a still pond.
hunks.sol: As one memory faded, another surfaced, as though someone were tossing stones one after another into a still pond.

hunks.baseline: The memories of that unknown person continued to throw the black knight’s mind into confusion.
hunks.sol: The memories of that unknown person continued to churn through the black knight’s mind.

hunks.baseline: A small number of people filled a vast space.
hunks.sol: A handful of people stood in a vast hall.

hunks.baseline: For some reason, he could not hear the name being called clearly, but his body moved on its own.
hunks.sol: For some reason, he could not make out the name being called, but his body moved on its own.

hunks.baseline: His disciplined stride was long, and his field of view was high.
hunks.sol: His disciplined strides were long, and his vantage point was much higher.

hunks.baseline: By then, he had grown into a young man. An older man in uniform approached and pinned a medal to his chest.
hunks.sol: He had grown into a young man. An older man in uniform approached and pinned a medal to his chest.

hunks.baseline: It was a familiar face. The same man he had seen in the first memory whispered quietly.
hunks.sol: It was a familiar face—the same man from the first memory. He leaned closer and whispered.

hunks.baseline: “Will you not regret this?”
hunks.sol: “Are you certain you won’t regret this?”

hunks.baseline: “I have no regrets. I did not regret it before, and I never will.”
hunks.sol: “I have no regrets. I never have, and I never will.”

hunks.baseline: “Most people will not know that you exist. You may have to live your entire life like a shadow.”
hunks.sol: “Most people will never know you exist. You may have to spend your entire life in the shadows.”

hunks.baseline: “I was taught that another name for a Hunter is a guardian. My honor does not disappear simply because I remain unseen.”
hunks.sol: “I was taught that a Hunter is also a guardian. Remaining unseen does not diminish my honor.”

hunks.baseline: “There is something I have not been able to tell you until now.”
hunks.sol: “There is something I’ve never told you.”

hunks.baseline: The older man’s hand tightened around his shoulder.
hunks.sol: The older man’s grip tightened on his shoulder.

hunks.baseline: “I’m proud of you. Thank you for growing up so well.”
hunks.sol: “I’m proud of you. Thank you for growing into such a fine man.”

hunks.baseline: The older man’s eyes grew damp beneath his bright smile.
hunks.sol: The older man smiled brightly, his eyes glistening with tears.

hunks.baseline: At the moment a single tear slid down his wrinkled cheek and fell onto the platform, another memory surfaced.
hunks.sol: The instant a single tear rolled down his wrinkled cheek and struck the platform, another memory surfaced.

hunks.baseline: “Hello? Is anyone there?”
hunks.sol: “Hello? Is anyone here?”

hunks.baseline: On a warm spring day, the place he visited was a small flower shop. As he looked around at the bright flowers and peered inside, she approached him.
hunks.sol: The place he visited on that warm spring day was a small flower shop. As he looked around at the vibrant flowers and peered farther inside, she approached him.

hunks.baseline: She walked with a buoyant step, and her eyes had the prim, coy look of a cat.
hunks.sol: Her steps were light and buoyant, her eyes prim and feline.

hunks.baseline: Her voice was so lively and bright. And so beautiful…
hunks.sol: Her voice was so cheerful and bright.
And she was so beautiful…

hunks.baseline: The black knight—or rather, a man who had passed through his youthful years and grown more mature—felt his heart pound.
hunks.sol: No longer an awkward youth but a grown man, the black knight—or rather, the man within the memory—felt his heart pound.

hunks.baseline: “Are you a customer?”
hunks.sol: “Sir?”

hunks.baseline: “No, I, um… I came to buy some fl-flowers.”
hunks.sol: “N-No, I… I came to buy some fl-flowers.”

hunks.baseline: “My parents. Strictly speaking, they aren’t my parents. It’s my uncle who raised me…”
hunks.sol: “My parents. Well, strictly speaking, he isn’t my parent. He’s my uncle, the man who raised me…”

hunks.baseline: “I see. But you speak very stiffly. Are you a soldier?”
hunks.sol: “I see. You speak so formally, though. Are you a soldier?”

hunks.baseline: “S-Something like that, ma’am.”
hunks.sol: “S-Something like that.”

hunks.baseline: It was a strange memory. His words kept breaking off, and everything before his eyes repeatedly turned white.
hunks.sol: It was a strange memory. His words kept catching in his throat, and his vision repeatedly went white.

hunks.baseline: When he came to his senses, he was walking dazedly into a hospital room with a bright bouquet of flowers in his arms.
hunks.sol: When he came to his senses, he was walking dazedly into a hospital room with a bright bouquet in his arms.

hunks.baseline: “You fool. I told you there was no need to come when it was only mild pneumonia… What’s that?”
hunks.sol: “You fool. I told you there was no need to come when it’s only mild pneumonia… What’s that?”

hunks.baseline: At Wei Fenghu’s question, he answered in a dazed voice.
hunks.sol: At Wei Fenghu’s question, he answered blankly.

hunks.baseline: “So you bought chrysanthemums as a get-well gift for me?”
hunks.sol: “So you bought me chrysanthemums as a get-well gift?”

hunks.baseline: “You ungrateful brat! Hey, you!”
hunks.sol: “You ungrateful brat! You little—!”

hunks.baseline: The man laughed even as he was beaten with the bouquet. A quiet laugh escaped him at his own stupidity, and he could not help laughing because she reminded him of chrysanthemums.
hunks.sol: The man laughed even as Wei Fenghu beat him with the bouquet. A chuckle escaped at his own stupidity, and he couldn’t help smiling when he thought of the woman who reminded him of chrysanthemums.
After that, the memories sped by.

hunks.baseline: After that, the memories began to flow rapidly. He visited the flower shop every day.
hunks.sol: He visited the flower shop every day.

hunks.baseline: “Ah, h-hello!”
hunks.sol: “H-Hello!”

hunks.baseline: “Welcome—oh my, you’re back again?”
hunks.sol: “Welcome—oh, you’re back again?”

hunks.baseline: By the time four seasons had passed, the relationship between the two was no longer that of a flower-shop owner and her customer.
hunks.sol: By the time all four seasons had passed, they were no longer merely a flower-shop owner and her customer.

hunks.baseline: “I have something to say.”
hunks.sol: “I have something to tell you.”

hunks.baseline: That was the longest of all the memories so far.
hunks.sol: Of all the memories he had seen, that one lasted the longest.

hunks.baseline: After a silence so long that a single second felt like ten years, or even a hundred, she finally opened her mouth.
hunks.sol: After a silence in which every second felt like ten years—like a hundred—she finally spoke.

hunks.baseline: “I have something to say, too.”
hunks.sol: “I have something to tell you too.”

hunks.baseline: “No, before that, let me hear your answer…”
hunks.sol: “No, first, let me hear your answer…”

hunks.baseline: The man’s heart pounded violently, and the black knight writhed in pain.
hunks.sol: The man’s heart hammered wildly, and the black knight writhed in agony.

hunks.baseline: “Ahhh! Aaaah!”
hunks.sol: “Aaah… Aaaaaah!”

hunks.baseline: His head hurt as if it were splitting apart, and it felt as though someone were wringing out his insides with their hands.
hunks.sol: His head felt as if it were splitting open, and it seemed as though someone were reaching inside him and wringing out his entire body.

hunks.baseline: Along with pain he had never even imagined, another memory forced its way into the empty space.
hunks.sol: Along with pain beyond anything he had ever imagined, another memory forced its way into the empty space.

hunks.baseline: “T-This child…”
hunks.sol: “Th-This child…”

hunks.baseline: “Honey, honey! Did you hear that? Our baby’s already saying ‘Dada.’ Could our baby be a genius?”
hunks.sol: “Honey! Honey, did you hear that? Our baby’s already saying ‘Dada.’ Do you think she’s a genius?”

hunks.baseline: “Could you change the diaper?”
hunks.sol: “Could you change her diaper?”

hunks.baseline: “Wait a moment. Let me hear it one more time.”
hunks.sol: “Wait. Let me hear it one more time.”

hunks.baseline: “Dada, Momma!”
hunks.sol: “Dada! Momma!”

hunks.baseline: The day the baby, bundled in a swaddling cloth and squirming helplessly, succeeded in rolling over.
hunks.sol: The day the tiny baby bundled in swaddling cloth managed to roll over.

hunks.baseline: The day he first crawled on all fours, and the day he first walked…
hunks.sol: The day she first crawled on all fours.
The day she took her first steps…

hunks.baseline: The man was happy as if he had gained the entire world.
hunks.sol: The man was as happy as if the entire world belonged to him.

hunks.baseline: But it did not take long for those dreamlike days to turn into a nightmare.
hunks.sol: But it did not take long for those dreamlike days to become a nightmare.

hunks.baseline: “Gaoping District? Keep trying to contact them, and mobilize and deploy the Second Regiment as a precaution.”
hunks.sol: “Gaoping District? Keep trying to establish contact, and mobilize the Second Regiment as a precaution.”

hunks.baseline: A disaster that struck without warning.
hunks.sol: Disaster struck without warning.

hunks.baseline: The man hurriedly assembled the forces under his command and headed for the source of the problem. There, he encountered a sight he could not believe.
hunks.sol: The man hurriedly assembled the forces under his command and headed for the source, only to find an unbelievable sight awaiting him.

hunks.baseline: “Kyawwwww!”
hunks.sol: “Kyaaaaaaa!”

hunks.baseline: “E-Everyone, run… Ghk!”
hunks.sol: “E-Everyone, run—guh!”

hunks.baseline: Slash! KABOOM!
hunks.sol: Crunch! KABOOM!

hunks.baseline: Flames rose into the sky above the peaceful city, while countless monsters slaughtered the humans on the ground.
hunks.sol: Flames billowed into the sky above the once-peaceful city, while countless monsters slaughtered people on the ground.

hunks.baseline: In that land overflowing with screams and death, the man drew his sword before the unbelievable scene of carnage.
hunks.sol: Before that unbelievable scene of carnage, in a land overflowing with screams and death, the man drew his sword.

hunks.baseline: Zzt!
hunks.sol: Zzzzt!

hunks.baseline: An aura blade rose around the blade, shining brilliantly.
hunks.sol: An aura blade surged around his sword, shining brilliantly.

hunks.baseline: More than a thousand Hunters answered the man’s cry with a resonant roar.
hunks.sol: More than a thousand Hunters answered his cry with a deafening roar.

hunks.baseline: They were humanity’s shield and guardians. They could not retreat even a single step.
hunks.sol: They were humanity’s shield and guardians.

hunks.baseline: With the Five-Starred Red Flag engraved on their armor, they advanced like a wave. Soon, instead of white foam, they broke apart in a spray of blood.
hunks.sol: With the Five-Starred Red Flag emblazoned on their armor, they surged forward like a wave—only to break apart in sprays of blood instead of white foam.

hunks.baseline: “Perish in the flames of hellfire, Fire Rain.”
hunks.sol: “Perish in the flames of hellfire. Fire Rain.”

hunks.baseline: Beneath the rain of falling flames, the man thought of his beloved wife and his five-year-old daughter.
hunks.sol: Beneath the falling rain of fire, the man thought of his beloved wife and five-year-old daughter.

hunks.baseline: “If you had run, you could have lived.”
hunks.sol: “If you had fled, you might have lived.”

hunks.baseline: At the sound of Jin Taekyung’s voice in his ear, the black knight’s body abruptly went rigid.
hunks.sol: At the sound of Jin Taekyung’s voice, the black knight’s body went rigid.

hunks.baseline: As a dam finally gave way, everything began to reassemble.
hunks.sol: The dam burst, and everything began to reassemble.

hunks.baseline: Thirty-six years of memories from his life as a human poured out like a tidal wave, obscuring his vision.
hunks.sol: Thirty-six years of memories from his life as a human crashed over him like a tidal wave, blotting out his vision.

hunks.baseline: —I am, I am…
hunks.sol: —I am… I am…

hunks.baseline: What in the world was he?
hunks.sol: What was he?

hunks.baseline: As the black knight trembled in confusion and pain, a thunderous voice rang out in his mind.
hunks.sol: As the black knight trembled in confusion and pain, a thunderous voice rang through his mind.

hunks.baseline: —You are my most loyal servant and the supreme commander of my legion. Your lord commands you: fulfill your duty until you crumble and wither into ash!
hunks.sol: —You are my most loyal servant and the supreme commander of my legion. Your lord commands you: fulfill your duty until you crumble into ash!

hunks.baseline: It was an irresistible word-spell.[^1]
hunks.sol: It was a word of power he could not resist.

hunks.baseline: The red eye-light that had been wavering like a candle before the wind flared fiercely.
hunks.sol: The red light in his eyes, wavering like a candle in the wind, suddenly blazed.

hunks.baseline: The black knight—or rather, Lei Fei—who had fallen with one strike still remaining, now erupted with tremendous mana from his entire body.
hunks.sol: The black knight—no, Lei Fei—had fallen with only one strike left to finish him.
